title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Analytics Platform
description: Built a full-stack analytics dashboard for a B2B SaaS startup, handling data ingestion, real-time reporting, and a Stripe-powered subscription model.
details: Architected the multi-tenant data layer using PostgreSQL row-level security, implemented a real-time event pipeline with Redis Streams, and integrated Stripe Billing with webhook handling for upgrades, downgrades, and failed payments. Delivered a white-label dashboard that clients could embed in their own products.
